plugin.name: Hearthstone Catgirl Companion
plugin.description: Read player-visible Hearthstone and Battlegrounds state to drive natural companionship from the active N.E.K.O character, including live constructed analysis and source-aware Battlegrounds advice.
plugin.short_description: Hearthstone and Battlegrounds companionship through the active N.E.K.O character.
panel.title: Hearthstone Catgirl Companion
panel.subtitle: Understand Hearthstone and Battlegrounds read-only so the active NEKO character can react naturally to facts and emotion cues.

sections.setup.title: Enable the Hearthstone Companion
setup.offlineHelp: You can grant permission and save your choices before Hearthstone starts. The plugin connects automatically when you open the game.
setup.connection.label: Game connection
setup.connection.connected: Connected to Hearthstone and reading the current player-visible game state.
setup.connection.bootstrap: Game data was found, but this log segment has no verified boundary yet. Waiting for more data.
setup.connection.degraded: The game connection needs attention. You can still save now and repair it at the bottom of the page.
setup.connection.waiting: Waiting for Hearthstone to start or produce game data. You can save settings now.
setup.connection.stopped: Log monitoring is stopped. You can still save settings and restart monitoring later in Diagnostics.
setup.monitor.title: 1. Monitor Hearthstone
setup.monitor.readyHelp: Power.log is being read-only monitored and the current game can be recognized.
setup.monitor.actionHelp: Configure Power.log. If monitoring is stopped, restart it from Diagnostics at the bottom of this page.
setup.consent.title: 1. Game-state Questions (On by Default)
setup.consent.help: After you enable the plugin, the active character can read filtered player-visible state when you ask, including your visible hand and choices. No separate confirmation is required, and you can turn this off at any time. It does not make the character speak first. Raw logs, player names, and hidden opponent cards are excluded.
setup.consent.enabledHelp: The active NEKO character can read filtered player-visible game state when you ask a question.
setup.consent.disabledHelp: Game-state sharing is off. Re-enable and save it before asking for live game or Battlegrounds advice.
setup.commentary.title: 2. Choose Proactive Companionship
setup.commentary.help: When enabled, the active character occasionally reacts at meaningful moments. Questions remain available when proactive companionship is off.
setup.commentary.enabledHelp: The active character will occasionally add one natural short reaction at important moments.
setup.commentary.disabledHelp: The character will not speak first. With consent enabled, it can still answer your questions.

runtime.lastErrorHelp: Use this code to diagnose Power.log path, access, or read failures.
settings.cardCatalogNetwork: Update the public Battlegrounds card catalog daily
settings.cardCatalogNetworkHelp: Uses fixed GET requests to hsbg.cards for the current catalog. No game state, card IDs, or player data is sent, but the service sees the IP, time, and plugin User-Agent. Disabling stops new requests and uses stale cached data when available.
overlay.unavailableHelp: This environment cannot create the standalone diagnostic overlay. Active-character commentary is unaffected.
recentCards.emptyHelp: Public cards will appear after they are observed in a game. Hidden opponent cards are never shown.
settings.logPathHelp: Leave blank for automatic discovery. Only set a Power.log file or containing directory when automatic connection fails or you use multiple instances.
settings.overlayEnabled: Allow explicit tests in the standalone transparent overlay
settings.llmConsent: Allow the active NEKO character to read filtered player-visible game state
settings.llmConsentHelp: This is enabled by default and covers normal-game turns, active side, public health/armor/mana, your currently visible hand and choices, hand/deck counts, public boards and recent plays; and in Battlegrounds, your visible hero choices, shop, hand and warband, gold, Tavern Tier, freeze state, lobby, last-observed opponent boards, public mechanics, attributed card facts, official season rules and aggregate-only local statistics. Specific hand cards are supplied on demand for user questions. Raw logs, player names, hidden opponent cards, secret identities and deck order are excluded.
settings.llmCommentary: Let the active character accompany key moments proactively
settings.llmDisabledHelp: Re-enable game-state sharing above before enabling proactive companionship.
settings.targetLanlanHelp: Leave blank to send filtered live public state to the only connected character; enter a target when multiple characters are connected. A role supplied by host context is cached in memory only. A fixed target also manages that character's Hearthstone scene.
privacy.localOnly: LLM data sharing is not authorized. The plugin only parses logs and aggregates statistics locally; it does not generate companion dialogue.
privacy.consentActive: Filtered player-visible-state sharing is enabled. Read-only tools may use it on demand when you ask; proactive requests also require LLM commentary to be enabled.
privacy.sharingEnabled: The active NEKO model is authorized to process filtered player-visible game state. Proactive companionship is shown separately.
privacy.sharingDisabled: The active NEKO model is not authorized to read game state. Local log monitoring still works.
privacy.publicStateSharing: Share filtered player-visible state with the LLM
privacy.cardCatalogNetwork: Connect to the public hsbg.cards catalog
privacy.cardCatalogGameState: Send game state or card IDs to the catalog
privacy.disclosure: The plugin follows Power.log read-only. It does not inspect the screen, inject into the game, or send game input. Catalog updates send no game state or card IDs, but hsbg.cards sees the IP, time, and plugin User-Agent. Filtered player-visible state is available to the active NEKO model provider on demand by default and can be disabled in the panel; raw logs, player names and hidden opponent information are excluded.
catalog.staleWarning: The cached card catalog is stale. Advice can still use it, but the character must identify its date and avoid treating it as current.
confirm.prepareLog.title: Configure Hearthstone logging?
confirm.prepareLog.message: The plugin will back up and update Hearthstone's log.config to enable Power.log. Restart Hearthstone afterward.
messages.overlayStarted: The standalone diagnostic overlay started. It only displays explicit test messages.
messages.logPreparedChanged: The game connection was configured. Fully exit and restart Hearthstone.
messages.logPreparedReady: The game connection is already configured. No restart is needed.
messages.logPathSaved: The custom game-data location was saved. The monitor will use it.
messages.logPathAutoDetection: Automatic discovery was restored. The plugin will connect when Hearthstone opens.
messages.savedLocalOnly: Local-only mode saved. No game state will be shared with the active NEKO model.
messages.savedQuestionsOnly: Game-state questions are enabled. The character will not speak first.
messages.savedWithCommentary: Game-state questions and proactive companionship are enabled.
messages.testCharacterSubmitted: The active character accepted the commentary test.
messages.testOverlaySubmitted: The standalone diagnostic overlay accepted the test. Proactive companionship is not enabled.

entries.query_constructed_state.name: Query the current Hearthstone match
entries.query_constructed_state.descript: Call when the user asks about the current constructed, Standard, Wild, or Arena match: turn, active side, mana, hand, board, Choice, or play advice. It reads fresh player-visible state every time. Use query_battlegrounds_state for Battlegrounds.
entries.query_battlegrounds_state.name: Query the current Battlegrounds state
entries.query_battlegrounds_state.descri: Call for current Battlegrounds questions about the shop, Tavern Spells, hero choices, composition, positioning, leveling, refreshing, freezing, tempo, opponents, or review. It returns actual costs, card types, golden state, current keywords, and evidence completeness; never fall back to constructed decks.
entries.query_battlegrounds_state.focus: Use shop for buying, leveling, or refreshing; board for composition, positioning, or combat; choice for heroes or discoveries; opponent for opponent information.

battlegroundsChoice.emptyHelp: Only choices that are explicitly exposed in the log are shown here; unobserved options are never inferred.
battlegroundsHeroChoices.observedHelp: Only choices that Power.log publicly exposes for the local player are shown; unobserved heroes are never inferred.
battlegroundsHeroChoices.emptyHelp: Wait for hero-selection log updates. An empty list does not mean the match has no choices.
battlegroundsLobby.emptyHelp: The lobby appears after hero entities with PLAYER_ID are observed, up to eight players.
battlegroundsShop.emptyHelp: The shop is shown only during Recruit, so combat copies are not misclassified as shop cards.
battlegroundsHand.emptyHelp: Only local hand cards that the current log can confirm are shown here.
battlegroundsWarband.emptyHelp: The warband updates with the live snapshot, including observed golden state and keywords.
battlegroundsStats.localOnly: Local history · patch {patch} · valid final placements only; this is not a global win rate.
battlegroundsStats.storageErrorHelp: The latest local statistics write could not be confirmed, so in-memory statistics may not be persisted. Keep the error code and check again after restarting the plugin.
battlegroundsSeason.name: Name
battlegroundsSeason.staticNotice: Static rules come from Blizzard's 36.2 patch notes. They contain no hero or minion performance data and do not infer the live pool.
